decision_conditions: It is hereby certified that the operations described in the 'Description of development' hereto in respect of the land specified in the 'Location of development' hereto and edged in red on the Location Plan (drawing number Location Plan Planning Portal Reference: PP-15056664v1) attached to this certificate, would have been lawful within the meaning of Section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended), for the following reason:
The works undertaken constitute lawful development for the purposes of implementing planning permission 47363/APP/2023/1245, in accordance with Section 56 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
description: Installation of a steel ridge beam to confirm the commencement of development approved under 47363/APP/2023/1245 prior to 21 June 2026 (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for an Existing Development)
